latest_release.body:
## [3.0.27](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/compare/v3.0.26...v3.0.27) (2026-10-28)

### Features

- **mp3:** Add standalone MP3 MSE playback with Range seek and native fallback. ([65f8649](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/65f86494c60872332e150c731925c06f456a2478))
- **mp4:** xgplayer-mp4 can now play on MSE/ManagedMediaSource (iOS 17.1+) via `preferMMS`, instead of always degrading to native video. ([322888e](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/322888e52ce2f5867468b903c3534702016621e7)), closes [#1932](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/issues/1932)
- range请求，增加 数据范围是否匹配检测 ([03a109c](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/03a109c95eaa456cf23c0b6c0c167dfc22c7fb26))
- support dynamic-timeout timeoutRatio, xhr fix endless request because of unpected net response ([2c89a2c](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/2c89a2c35cee4f69e5331e3a3cb149ce530c80d4))
- 优化range请求时，返回200状态码问题 ([e43c93b](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/e43c93b458c5909f678beaf0e3de72fc81db289d))

### Bug Fixes

- **dash:** parse MPD durations with any combination of H, M and S ([f9c8ad2](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/f9c8ad2ef106b3e46c69e176b24c9d78a450bdff))
- **hls:** preserve playlist path for query-only URIs ([5af9e7d](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/5af9e7d7c98b76f33b35a9c8e7b729664923862b))
- **hls:** Prevent fixture values from being interpreted as HTML. ([202d5f6](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/202d5f6a01569278346fbd81e129768f501cdd52))
- **monorepo:** Harden cast lifecycle handling and TypeScript buffer compatibility. ([2f135fc](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/2f135fc492e0adf3ece53babb043edf3804d7b21))
- **monorepo:** Include package changelogs in npm distributions. ([87cf0de](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/87cf0ded4749631e650dc8517c6bff38557d5e36))
- **monorepo:** Keep package changelogs and published archives consistent across tag-driven releases. ([6af6c83](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/6af6c83b3d90e43a241fe06142b0562646008430))
- **monorepo:** Reject outdated release tags before generating package metadata. ([f3d83ce](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/f3d83ceadac289788a4482ef44b3d88e4310988e))
- **mp4:** Fix fragmented MP4 playback, source switching, buffer eviction, and stall recovery in xgplayer-mp4. ([3c417a5](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/3c417a580e1204631bf426823270a205abfd08a6)), closes [#1875](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/issues/1875) [#1911](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/issues/1911) [#1932](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/issues/1932) [#1935](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/issues/1935)
- **transmuxer:** accept minimum 4-byte UTF-8 sequence U+10000 ([ea781cd](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/ea781cdee035873ad43a802c4ee23ad65d7d937f))
- **transmuxer:** Avoid emitting zero-duration video samples for PES data without timestamps. ([65b6a0e](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/65b6a0ec223e3a92d55c4453df419197806967d4))
- **transmuxer:** Fix HEVC decode failures across implicit stream discontinuities. ([d72119a](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/d72119a14514711b5cf4ea35a33e2a6fcc53a4fc))
- **transmuxer:** Keep video samples after timestamp recovery. ([4aabb65](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/4aabb65d5d3ef5cf695b035b2c8d388c3edea8c5))
- **xgplayer-mp3:** Add MP3 range-loading playback support with safer teardown and native fallback behavior. ([613c02b](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/613c02bfae983092d52e7d660e20dd385d3a02c1))
- **xgplayer-mp3:** Fix MP3 completion, backward seeking, source preprocessing, native fallback state, and VBR seek metadata. ([fe8049c](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/commit/fe8049cd1bc31dc4b87d4d009689c2740576b7f8))
- **xgplayer-mp3:** Fix MP3 range loading, seeking, duration correction, and playNext lifecycle edge cases. ([df01285](https://github.com/bytedance/xgplayer/

detail.readme:
# xgplayer xgplayer provides a flexible, plugin-based media player for web applications. Its UI components, loading strategies, and format integrations can be composed independently. [Documentation](https://h5player.bytedance.com/en/) ## Installation ```bash npm install xgplayer ``` ## Usage ```html
``` ```js import Player from 'xgplayer' import 'xgplayer/dist/index.min.css' const player = new Player({ id: 'player', url: 'https://s2.pstatp.com/cdn/expire-1-M/byted-player-videos/1.0.0/xgplayer-demo.mp4' }) ``` See the [configuration documentation](https://h5player.bytedance.com/en/config/) for additional player options. ## Plugins xgplayer provides built-in UI plugins and optional streaming or feature packages. See the [plugin documentation](https://h5player.bytedance.com/en/plugins/) for available integrations. ## Development The repository uses Yarn 1.x. Fixture commands start local demos for each format: ```bash yarn yarn dev:xgplayer ``` ```bash yarn dev:hls yarn dev:flv yarn dev:mp4 ``` ## Release See the [release guideline](.github/release-guideline.md) for stable and prerelease workflows. ## License By using xgplayer, you agree to the following terms: 1. xgplayer is licensed under the [MIT License](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT). 2. You authorize the xgplayer project to display the logo of a business using xgplayer on the project website.
detail.readme_zh:
# xgplayer xgplayer 为 Web 应用提供灵活、插件化的媒体播放器。UI 组件、加载策略和媒体格式能力 均可按需组合。 [文档](https://h5player.bytedance.com/) ## 安装 ```bash npm install xgplayer ``` ## 使用 ```html
``` ```js import Player from 'xgplayer' import 'xgplayer/dist/index.min.css' const player = new Player({ id: 'player', url: 'https://s2.pstatp.com/cdn/expire-1-M/byted-player-videos/1.0.0/xgplayer-demo.mp4' }) ``` 更多播放器选项参见[配置文档](https://h5player.bytedance.com/config/)。 ## 插件 xgplayer 提供内置 UI 插件以及可选的流媒体和功能包。可用能力参见 [插件文档](https://h5player.bytedance.com/plugins/)。 ## 开发调试 仓库使用 Yarn 1.x。以下命令用于启动各格式的本地示例： ```bash yarn yarn dev:xgplayer ``` ```bash yarn dev:hls yarn dev:flv yarn dev:mp4 ``` ## 发布流程 稳定版本、预发布版本及发版命令参见[发布指南](.github/release-guideline.zh-CN.md)。 ## 使用协议 使用 xgplayer 即表示同意以下条款： 1. 本项目基于 [MIT License](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) 发布。 2. 您授权 xgplayer 项目在官网展示使用 xgplayer 的业务 Logo。
